definitions.explanation: A formal, respectful term for someone else's son, used in writing or polite speech. Often appears in news, invitations, and business correspondence. Frequently prefixed with ご as ご{子息|しそく}.

examples.japanese: ご{子息|しそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{会|あ}い→会う：00482_au⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{子息|しそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: The president's son was put in charge of the new branch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ご{子息|しそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晴|は}れ{姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝見|はいけん}→拝見：02082_haiken⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{光栄|こうえい}→光栄：19436_kouei⟧でした。
examples.english: It was an honor to see your son in his wedding attire.

notes:
Used only in reference to someone else's son — never one's own. Almost always appears with the honorific prefix ご as ご{子息|しそく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{子息|しそく}: your/his/her son (polite)
- ご{子息|しそく}⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: even more polite, used in formal writing
- ご{子息|しそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce one's son (when speaking of another's)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧: son — neutral term; used for one's own or another's son in casual speech
- ご{令息|れいそく}: your son — even more formal than ご{子息|しそく}
- {愚息|ぐそく}: my (humble) son — used by parents to refer to their own son humbly

REGISTER:
Formal/written. Avoid in casual conversation, where ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧さん is more natural.
